name: Trustco Group Holdings Limited
source: Yahoo Finance | JSEBLOCKED 17 Nov 2026: trading in the shares has been suspended on the JSE since December 2024. The audited statements for the years ended 31 August 2024 and 31 August 2025 are still outstanding; the SENS of 1 April 2026 states that Nexia SAB&T is being appointed group auditor for both years, and the company has told shareholders the outstanding audits are expected to complete in the fourth quarter of 2026. Verified at https://tgh.na/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Trustco-auditor-appointment-1-April-2026-SENS-Announcement.pdf
